remarks: Ranch style home! On 30-acres custom home in the Kings Canyon community. Amazing VIEWS of the north and west valley. So much room for the animals  &  toys of your choice. This is this peaceful retreat and offers privacy and tons of potentials opportunity. Open floor concept to the living room and formal dining room. The kitchen offers generous workspace and storage, including a spacious pantry and lots of cabinetry and counter space provided excellent storage. The standing range remains with the sale. The natural light is part of every living area and bedroom in this home. Outside offers chain-link fencing, wide-open space to enjoy the VIEWS. Enjoy the fruit trees. Lots of sheds and pen
